decisions.reason: Healthcare and hospitality recruitment is outside the firm's maritime core and only gets brief website mentions, so it carries some risk of being dropped, but it uses the existing crew-recruitment infrastructure at low cost.
Superyacht crew recruitment is close to the core crewing business and cheap to run alongside it, so it is likely to stay.
The Smart Academy is a strategic training initiative whose partner network grew to six maritime institutions within months of its April 2024 launch.
FuelEU Maritime compliance is an ongoing legal requirement, and the firm met the monitoring-plan deadline for all vessels, making this a core service.
The dashboard is fully integrated into the PAL ship management software and supports mandatory FuelEU compliance, so it will be retained.
The cost simulator is integrated into PAL and helps clients plan FuelEU compliance costs, so it remains valuable as the regulation takes effect.
